summary: # **Shri P.K Pujari, Chairperson Shri A.K. Singhal, Member Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member** Approval of slab rates for POC Charges and losses for the period July to September 2018, under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2010 and amendments thereto. The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission had issued order dated 30.8.2018 approving slab rates for PoC Charges towards ‘LTA/MTOA and STOA’, Reliability Support Charge Rate, HVDC Charge Rate as well as slabs for PoC losses for the Application Period July – September, 2018. 2. It has come to our notice that an error in the calculation of PoC Slabs rate has crept in with regard to the yearly transmission charges of Chhattisgarh WR Transmission Limited which was not considered in calculation of PoC Slab Rates for July – September, 2018 by the Implementing Agency i.e the respondent, NLDC. 3. Accordingly, table in Para 6 (a) , table in Para 6 (b), Annexure- II and Annexure- III of the order dated 30.8.2018 in which PoC slabs Rates and Reliability Support Charges Rates for LTA/MTOA and STOA billing have been revised. HVDC charges rate shall continue to be charged as per order dated 30.8.2018. The revised Annexure-II and Annexure- III is annexed with this order. # 4. The revised table of Para 6(a) slabs for POC rates for LTA / MTOA are as follows:- |PoC Slab|(`/MW/Month)| |---|---| |I|422677| |II|376841| |III|331005| |IV|285169| |V|239332| |VI|193496| |VII|147660| |VIII|101824| |IX|55988| |PoC Slab|(paisa/unit)| |---|---| |I|30.99| |II|27.21| |III|23.43| |IV|19.65| |V|15.87| |VI|12.09| |VII|8.31| |VIII|4.53| |IX|0.75| 6. The revised rates for STOA as per this order shall be effective from the next date of 7. RPC is directed to issue revised RTA within a week of issue of this order and CTU to raise bills within 2 days thereafter. Further Implementing Agency is directed to ensure that in future such errors are avoided while calculating PoC rates to avoid revision of rates for all DICs. **Sd/Sd/Sd/(Dr. M.K. Iyer) (A.K.
